description: This header file declares the external API functions for the CCSP CWMP ACS connection object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions used across the CCSP CWMP implementation.

methods.name: CcspCwmpCreateAcsConnection
methods.description: Creates a new ACs Connection object with specified container, owner, and reserved context handles.

methods.name: CcspCwmpAcscoCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes the CCSP CWMP ACS connection object.

methods.name: CcspCwmpAcscoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified ACS connection object, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: CcspCwmpAcscoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects within the ACS connection object.
